name: SMOL SmolSent, English-Filipino (google/smol, smolsent/en_fil)
notes: smolsent/en_fil and smolsent/fil_en contain the same 754 pairs reversed (same ids, same text).
Professional translation; Filipino side written for SMOL (released 2025), so it postdates MADLAD-400 [inference].
Exact-match check vs all 63,581,148 NLLB en-tl lines: 0 of 754 found on either side (2026-10-08).
Mean 14.2 English / 16.1 Filipino words; po/opo in 1 pair; non-initial 'ay' in 21.
A5 section-3 n-gram check (task C1) still to run before the set is frozen.
